### Day 253: Acts 15:39–41
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-253-acts-15-3941.html
Passage: Acts 15:39-41
Points:
- Believers can hold sharp differences over ministry without letting convictions devolve into bitter contention.
- Discern the genuine cause of conflict by inviting the Holy Spirit to reveal pride or selfishness.
- Submit the disagreement fully to God to avoid giving the enemy an opportunity to divide.
- Restrain anger so emotional reactions do not lead to sinful words or damaging actions.
- Commit to praying for and with one another to seek God's glory above personal positions.
